content: When CanIf_Transmit() is called with PduInfoPtr->Sd- uLength exceeding the length of the global PDU (see [ECUC_EcuC_00078]) refer- enced by TxPduId and CanIfTxPduTruncation is disabled, CanIf shall report the runtime error CANIF_E_TXPDU_LENGTH_EXCEEDED and return E_NOT_OK with- out further actions.

When CanIf_Transmit() is called with PduInfoPtr->Sd- uLength exceeding the maximum length of the PDU referenced by TxPduId and CanIfTxPduTruncation is disabled, CanIf shall report the runtime error CANIF_- E_TXPDU_LENGTH_EXCEEDED and return E_NOT_OK without further actions.

When CanIf_Transmit() is called with PduInfoPtr->Sd- uLength exceeding the length of the global PDU (see [ECUC_EcuC_00078]) refer- enced by TxPduId and CanIfTxPduTruncation is disabled, CanIf shall report the runtime error CANIF_E_TXPDU_LENGTH_EXCEEDED and return E_NOT_OK with- out further actions.

When CanIf_Transmit() is called with PduInfoPtr->Sd- uLength exceeding the length of the global PDU (see [ECUC_EcuC_00078]) refer- enced by TxPduId and CanIfTxPduTruncation is disabled, CanIf shall report the runtime error CANIF_E_TXPDU_LENGTH_EXCEEDED and return E_NOT_OK with- out further actions.
